title: mentha longifolia
intro: Mentha longifolia, commonly known as Hoary Mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia include its antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hoary Mint include menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid, among others, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
